breakingChange: node-fetch 3 is ESM-only, so require('node-fetch') returns the module namespace and the fetch function is on its default export. Three modules call the bare require result (one inside a retry loop, one inside a nested closure); src/headers.js only destructures Headers and src/status.js already reads .default, both of which still work, and src/docs.js only mentions node-fetch in a string.
